plan_notes.relevance: AI must be what makes the story happen (AI x film/TV/animation/VFX production, tools, deals, labor/likeness). Drop generic box-office or festival news with no AI axis, and pure AI-industry funding noise.
plan_notes.output_key: Write candidates under the key "items" (NOT "candidates") — dedup_candidates.py crashes otherwise.
